##2. Simulation
```{r}
result <- NULL
for (i in (1:100)){
  t_final=40
  changpoint=26
  data<-sim_changepointPP(changpoint,c(0.5,3),t_final)
  d0=20
  W=40
  alpha=0.05
  lamb0<-intensity(data,0,d0,t_final)
  lamb0
  x<-Alarme_SR(data,lamb0,d0,W,alpha,t_final,Vesbose=FALSE)
  result <- rbind(result,c(lamb0,abs(x-changpoint)))}
```

```{r}
summary(result)
```

Summary data

```{r}
result <- bind_rows(
  lapply(dataset, function(dataset) {

    dat <- as.data.frame(
      get(dataset, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    )

    names(dat)[1:3] <- c("ID belier", "ID brebis","time")

    dates <- as.Date(dat$time)
    data.frame(
      dataset = dataset,
      nb_brebis = n_distinct(dat$`ID brebis`, na.rm = TRUE),
      date_start = min(dates),
      date_end = max(dates),
      nb_days = as.numeric(max(dates) - min(dates)) + 1
    )
  })
)

result
```

# II. Application our algorithms to dataset
## 1. Genaral function
These functions below prepares the data for algorithms: standardizes column names, converts event timestamps to a unified time scale (hours or days), and sets markers for "before" and "after" (e.g., 1).


```{r}
prepare_algorithm_data <- function(dat, time_unit = "hours") {
  
  dat <- as.data.frame(dat)
  names(dat)[1:3] <- c("ID_belier", "ID_brebis", "time")
  
  
  day_start <- floor_date(min(dat$time, na.rm = TRUE), unit = "day")
  day_end   <- ceiling_date(max(dat$time, na.rm = TRUE), unit = "day")
  
  if (time_unit == "hours") {
    t_final <- as.numeric(difftime(day_end, day_start, units = "hours"))
    scale_time <- 3600
  } else {
    t_final <- as.numeric(difftime(day_end, day_start, units = "days"))
    scale_time <- 3600 * 24
  }
  
  dat_epic <- dat %>%
    mutate(
      event_time = as.numeric(difftime(time, day_start, units = "secs")) / scale_time,
      TIMES = 1
    ) %>%
transmute(
  id_original = ID_brebis,
  id = as.integer(factor(ID_brebis)),
  id_char = as.character(ID_brebis),
  time = as.numeric(event_time),
  marks = as.numeric(TIMES),
  numAlpha = as.character(ID_belier),
  ram = as.character(ID_belier)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(id_original),
      !is.na(id),
      !is.na(time),
      !is.na(marks),
      !is.na(numAlpha)
    ) %>%
    arrange(id, time)
  
  list(
    dat_epic = dat_epic,
    t_final = t_final,
    day_start = day_start,
    day_end = day_end
  )
}
```

```{r}
prep_fage23 <- prepare_algorithm_data(
  dat = Corse2024,
  time_unit = "hours"
)
```

```{r}
prep_corse24$dat_epic

```

```{r}
d0=25
data <- prep_corse24$dat_epic
prep_corse24$t_final
prep_corse24$dat_epic[prep_corse24$dat_epic$time <= d0,]
lamb0<-nrow(prep_corse24$dat_epic[prep_corse24$dat_epic$time <= d0,])/(d0*length(unique(data$id)))
lamb0
```

```{r}

t_final<-prep_corse24$t_final
W=24
alpha=0.05
for (i in unique(data$id)){
  data_i<-data[data$id==i,]
  x<-Alarme_SR(data_i,lamb0,d0,W,alpha,t_final,Vesbose=FALSE)
  cat(data_i$id_original[1], ": alarm at ",x ,"\n")
  
}
```
